title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia builds AI fluency at scale
summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia partners with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to 50,000 employees, building AI fluency at scale to improve customer service and fraud response.
body: Commonwealth Bank of Australia partners with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to 50,000 employees, building AI fluency at scale to improve customer service and fraud response.
summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦银行（CBA）与OpenAI达成合作，将向其50,000名员工推广使用ChatGPT Enterprise。此举旨在通过大规模提升员工的AI素养，优化客户服务体验并增强银行的欺诈响应能力。该合作是金融行业大规模采用生成式AI的典型案例，展示了企业如何通过工具赋能实现业务流程的智能化升级。
